stories.title: US military says it allowed 40 vessels carrying humanitarian aid to pass through Hormuz blockade
stories.summary: US military says it allowed 40 vessels carrying humanitarian aid to pass through Hormuz blockade US Central Command (Centcom) said on Monday that the military has redirected 71 commercial vessels, disabled 3 and boarded 2 to "ensure compliance" with its naval blockade of Iranian ports. In a post to X, Centcom added that more than 40 vessels supporting humanitarian aid were allowed to pass through the blockade by the US navy. American forces aboard USS George H.W. Bush (CVN 77) remain vigilant and ready both day and night during enforcement of the U.S. blockade against Iran. As of Aug. 24, CENTCOM forces have redirected 71 commercial vessels, disabled 3 and boarded 2 to ensure compliance

stories.headline: Forcing women to drink at business dinners has no place in modern China

opening: Reports of a female employee allegedly being assaulted at a drinking party in Hangzhou brought back a version of myself from more than a decade ago.
Back then, I was one of those young women routinely invited to business dinners.
body: Seating followed an unwritten rule, with the most powerful person taking the seat of honour, flanked by two young women.
Everyone knew what we were there to do: keep the conversation lively, entertain the guests and, above all, keep raising our glasses.
